description: List tags (Breeze's groups/lists) with id, name, created_on and folder_id, optionally only those in one folder. To list the people in a tag, call breeze_list_people with filter {"tag_contains":"y_<tag_id>"}. Breeze: GET /api/tags/list_tags.

folder_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the tag folder.

name: breeze_list_tags
title: List tags
